strategy.summary: The project HERMES Mail/X aims to enhance the email experience for Apple users by developing a new email client. The strategy includes pursuing two approaches for the Macintosh interface, either rewriting the user interface from the Windows version or starting a separate project based on the Macintosh version's code. The project is currently funded by multiple backers and is exploring various technical routes to achieve its objectives.

innovation.summary: The project focuses on the development of HERMES Mail/X as a successor to Eudora, aiming to enhance email functionality and user experience. Key innovations include support for Unicode, integration of a spelling checker, and a redesigned interface built from the ground up, addressing limitations of the original Eudora.
key_points: HERMES Mail/X will support Unicode (UTF-8) and enable messaging in all left-to-right alphabetic languages.
The new version will include a spelling checker or support the existing one in OS X.
